title: TREASURY TO ISSUE NEW 20-YEAR BOND IN FIRST HALF OF 2020 | U.S. Department of the Treasury
publication_quote: January 16, 2020 WASHINGTON — The U.S. Department of the Treasury today announced it plans to issue a 20-year nominal coupon bond in the first half of calendar year 2020.
